headline: Equinix (NASDAQ:EQIX) Soars on Q2 Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
summary: Equinix smashed Q2 earnings estimates with EPS of $11.78, revenue nearly inline at $2.625B, and raised full-year guidance, sending shares up 2.18%.

headline: Equinix Declares Quarterly Dividend on Its Common Stock
summary: Equinix, Inc. (Nasdaq: EQIX), the world's digital infrastructure company®, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $5.16 per share on its common stock. The quarterly common stock dividend will be paid on September 16, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 19, 2026.
